violations.description: CROSS CONTAMINATION (5 pts): Raw meats and eggs noted being stored above food not to be further cooked or prepared in the kitchen's 1 door upright cooler and in the 2 door upright cooler.

EMPLOYEE HYGIENE (5 pts): Employee noted handling food products and clean utensils after contaminating hands by handling drill for mixing sauces. Kitchen staff noted handling food contact items and continued to cook with contaminated hands due to the kitchen hand wash station not being fully accessable and supplied with soap and papertowels.

HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): Hand washing lavatory in kitchen noted blocked with mixing bowel and bucket on the floor. Soap was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the kitchen. Soap was noted not provided at the hand washing lavatory in the kitchen.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of fish chicken bean sprouts and other ingredients in the upright kitchen cooler was noted not being properly dated for disposition.

CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Many food items in upright coolers in the kitchen do not have destriptions or accurate descriptions noted on the food containers. Multiple bags of different meats observed in upright freezers unidentified in the main floor storage rooms.

THAWING POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (2 pts): Potentially hazardous foods noted not being thawed using approved methods. Observed frozen fish being thawed in buckets of water at 65 degrees. Vacuum sealed packages being thawed in the under counter sushi cooler unopened and exposed to oxygen.
CONTAMINATION FROM WIPING CLOTHS (2 pts): Wiping cloths noted laying on counter in kitchen.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Prep top and undercounter cooler interiors and door gaskets not properly maintained. Observed heavy debris build up and moisture at the bottom of the coolers.
SINGLE - USE/SINGLE - SERVICE ARTICLES (1 pts): Single use soup containers being reused to dispense flour rice and sauces in the kichen and basement storage area.
CONTAMINATION DURING STORAGE (2 pts): Food noted not properly labeled in the basement chest freezer storage room upright freezer kitchen upright single door coolers.
THAWING POTENTIALLY HAZARDOUS FOOD (2 pts): Commercially vacuum packaged fish in the sushi undercounter coolers thawing without removing from or opening the vacuum bag.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of fish was noted not being properly dated for disposition in the chest freezers and various ingredients in the single door upright coolers in the kitchen.
FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Kitchen reachin cooler interiors not properly maintained.
TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES (1 pts): Sushi refrigerator and basement and storage room upright freezers noted with thermometer not in a conspicuous location.
HANDWASHING LAVATORIES AND SUPPLIES (3 pts): The kitchen hand washing lavatory noted with no hot water provided.

FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (2 pts): Reachin cooler and freezer interior not properly maintained. Prep top cooler 3 door upright cooler interior sushi bar under counter coolers and under counter kitchen freezer have debris build up.

POT HAZ RTE FOOD DATING AND DISPOSITION (2 pts): Ready to eat potentially hazardous food in the form of chicken and beef was noted not being properly dated for disposition in the kitchen prep top cooler.
NON FOOD CONTACT SURFACES - CLEAN (1 pts): Shelves and equipment exteriors in the kitchen observed with debris build up on wire shelving and mainly around equipment door handles.
TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES (1 pts): Sushi under counter coolers noted with no thermometer.

SINGLE - USE/SINGLE - SERVICE ARTICLES (1 pts): Cups and sushi containers noted being stored on the floor in the basement storage area. Spoons and soup containers observed being reused as food scoops for ingredients and in bulk rice bins.
